title: Blood Tendency
subtitle: What the blood remembers killing
text: Blood Tendency is the elemental alignment of your blood, shaped by what you have killed and consumed over time. Practitioners usually name these tendencies by their enzyme signs: Vivacious, Fervent, Frigid, Ruinous, Incandescent, Umbral, Neurotic, and Ferric. Older Harbinger records use the alchemical names Animus, Flammeus, Congeatio, Mortem, Lux, Tenebris, Ductilis, and Ferric. Both vocabularies point to the same truth: the blood remembers what formed it.
